data.name: Guard Her
data.detailed_description:
# "Guard her"— A Strategic Tower Defense Game

**Defend the Goddess. Defeat the Monsters.**

"Guard her" is a classic strategy tower defense game. Your mission is to build towers, eliminate waves of monsters, and protect the Goddess at all costs.

## Features

**6 Unique Towers**

- **Cannon Tower** — High single-target damage, stable output, best against high-HP enemies

- **Missile Tower** — Splash damage, wipes out dense enemy groups

- **Frost Tower** — Slows enemies down, buys time for your other towers

- **Airport Tower** — Deploys patrol airplanes for wide-area coverage

- **Beacon / Accelerator / Amplifier** — Support towers that boost nearby towers' range, attack speed, or damage

**Path Control Mechanics**

Strategically place towers to redirect enemy movement — the longer the path, the easier the kill.

**Upgrade & Convert System**

- Each tower can be upgraded to level 3 with the full version ( level 2 for free experience), greatly boosting damage, range, and fire rate

- Convert level 1 towers into support towers for a game-changing advantage

**4 Enemy Types**

Normal, Fast, Tank, and a Boss every 10 waves. Enemy stats scale as waves progress.

**Rich Gameplay**

- 5 difficulty levels for all skill levels with the full version.
  (3 difficulty levels for all skill levels for free experience.)

- Up to 16× game speed to breeze through early waves

- Full keyboard controls (1-4 select towers, P pause, T speed, Space start wave)

- Save & load your progress anytime

- Best wave records tracked per difficulty

**Free to play, one purchase unlocks the full game!**
